name: IRS Data Book by state: returns filed, gross tax collections and refunds, fiscal years 2019 to 2025
description: Returns and other forms filed, gross tax collections and refunds issued, from the Internal Revenue Service Data Book state tables, for the nation, each state, DC and Puerto Rico and each fiscal year (October to September) from 2019 to 2025: returns by form type (individual, employment, C corporation, S corporation, partnership), collections by type of tax (individual income and employment, withheld, business income, estate, gift, excise) and the number and amount of refunds. Dollar amounts are in dollars; IRS prints them in thousands. The national record also holds what IRS counts in the nation but assigns to no state.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). IRS Data Book by state: returns filed, gross tax collections and refunds, fiscal years 2019 to 2025 (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963674

distribution.name: irs-databook.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: irs-databook.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: irs-databook-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in irs-databook-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to irs-databook.csv on id.

recordSet.name: irs-databook
recordSet.description: The records of IRS Data Book by state: returns filed, gross tax collections and refunds, fiscal years 2019 to 2025, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code (50 states, DC, PR), or US

field.name: level
field.description: state or us

field.name: fiscalYear
field.description: IRS fiscal year, October of the prior year to September (2025 = October 2024 to September 2025)

field.name: status
field.description: P: IRS's own published figure

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Gross tax collections in dollars (the same as collections_total)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: returns_total
field.description: Returns and other forms filed (excludes information returns)

field.name: returns_individual
field.description: Individual income tax returns (Form 1040 series)

field.name: returns_employment
field.description: Employment tax returns

field.name: returns_c_corp
field.description: C or other corporation income tax returns

field.name: returns_s_corp
field.description: S corporation returns

field.name: returns_partnership
field.description: Partnership returns

field.name: collections_total
field.description: Gross collections in dollars, including penalties and interest

field.name: collections_business
field.description: Business income taxes

field.name: collections_individual_employment
field.description: Individual income, employment and estate and trust income taxes

field.name: collections_withheld
field.description: Individual income tax withheld, including Social Security and Medicare

field.name: collections_individual_payments
field.description: Individual income tax payments

field.name: collections_estate
field.description: Estate tax

field.name: collections_gift
field.description: Gift tax

field.name: collections_excise
field.description: Excise taxes

field.name: refunds_number_total
field.description: Number of refunds issued

field.name: refunds_number_individual
field.description: Number of individual income tax refunds

field.name: refunds_amount_total
field.description: Amount of refunds issued, in dollars, including interest

field.name: refunds_amount_individual
field.description: Individual income tax refunds, in dollars

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
